title: Sensorimotor word norms: An overview
description:
Overview of published sensorimotor rating norms for words across languages (perceptual strength, sensory experience, perceptual features, bodily involvement, effector relatedness, manipulability and body-object interaction). One row per paper and language; one row per rating scale with its coding into six categories; citation links between the papers with a network analysis (R, igraph); reference list (APA, BibTeX, RIS); codebook; the interactive web page; and the code that builds everything from the source data.

Data and documentation: CC BY 4.0. Code: MIT License.
